newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain economy on track for 3 pct 1997 growth - government.
newsitem.headline: Spain economy on track for 3 pct 1997 growth - government.

text.p: The Spanish economy is on track for three percent growth in 1997 as the government forecast, government spokesman Miguel Angel Rodriguez said on Friday.

"If the economy continues to develop as foreseen...the objective for three percent growth in gross domestic product will be reached," Rodriguez told journalists at a news conference following the weekly cabinet meeting.
